name: XX_champion aura firewall invis anchor
comment: What a champion's Firewall aura spawns (SpawnMonster ZVJ2, 636582) on a player within 10 m: the invisible centre of the fire on the ground (636581 cast on it: 506109, a ground effect starting after 4 s, 25 pulses 0.25 s apart). The template (TDB 51000 #2766) matches the hash by name only; the invisible look as other anchors, level and health, and a lifetime covering the ground effect are guesses.
